title: hedyotis tetrangularis
intro: Hedyotis tetrangularis, commonly known as Chinese harebell or rosin rose, is a flowering plant native to Asia and used in traditional medicine. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Hedyotis tetrangularis include promoting wound healing, reducing oxidative stress, and exhibiting immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
